info.name: Public Prewave Actions Scores - Target API
Returns the target score including the overall score and scores for all infotag-groups.

params.name: systemId
params.description: The system ID is an identifier to determine from which the targetId might originate from. Supported systemIds are "prewave", "customer", "supplier", "own".

params.name: targetId
params.description: The target ID can be the target's prewaveId or an external id (edge number) representing the site in another system.

params.name: perspectiveId
params.description: Id of the perspective, that should be used to calculate the target-score.

params.name: groupId
params.description: Id of the group that items should be returned

params.name: component
params.description: Filter by score component

params.name: subcomponent
params.description: Filter by score subcomponent
